meta.title: Flagged for review
meta.subtitle: Items this desk could not settle from an official source. None of them block the site going live. Each one has the source that was checked, what is missing, and the exact step that would close it.
meta.policy: Nothing on this page is a claim about a product. Everything here is a statement about our own verification, and every one of them links to the official page that was read.

flags.title: None of the five submitted tokens can be an ASIN
flags.what_we_checked: Amazon defines an ASIN as a 10-character alphanumeric unique identifier. Every one of the five submitted tokens was measured: B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3, B00hJ57DV, B0c8moW59 and B0f3GKalj are each 9 characters, so none of them is ASIN-shaped. Every observed destination is a 10-character ASIN. The lengths were re-measured during integration on 2026-11-20 after an earlier draft of this register miscounted two of them.
flags.what_is_missing: Nothing public binds a short link token to a product, so the intent behind each link cannot be read from any source.
flags.impact: If the tag is wrong, clicks still reach Amazon but the sale may not be attributed, and every Special Link on the site needs to change.
flags.how_to_close: Open Associates Central, copy the Store ID from the account header, and paste it into data/config.json as affiliate.tracking_id. Re-run the build.

flags.title: The intended ASIN for each submitted link is unconfirmed
flags.what_we_checked: Amazon defines an ASIN as a 10-character alphanumeric unique identifier. All five submitted tokens are 9 characters, so none of them can be an ASIN, and each observed destination is a 10-character ASIN.
flags.what_is_missing: Nothing in the public record binds a short link token to a specific product, so the intent behind each link cannot be read from any public source.
flags.impact: The register can state where each link goes today. It cannot state what was meant. Both facts are kept in separate fields and neither is merged into the other.
flags.how_to_close: The owner confirms the intended ASIN and listing URL for each of the five links. Until then the intended fields stay blank by design.

flags.title: The submitted short links are not the format this site publishes
flags.what_we_checked: Amazon's Program Policies require that Special Links be accessed directly from your Site, restrict Redirecting Links and restrict link shorteners that make it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site.
flags.what_is_missing: Nothing is missing in the rules; the point is that the five submitted link.amazon URLs are Amazon-hosted redirects rather than direct Special Links carrying the Associates tag. Whether each short link is enrolled in the owner's Associates workflow is a private fact that cannot be read from a public page, so no compliance verdict is stated here.
flags.impact: If the short links are not already enrolled, replacing them with direct Special Links is what makes the click attributable.
flags.how_to_close: Open one submitted link in the enrolled Associates workflow, confirm the destination and the tracking report, then publish direct Special Links for the rest. Do not scale until one link has been confirmed end to end.

flags.title: The submitted tokens are not live ASINs either
flags.what_we_checked: A direct fetch of www.amazon.com/dp/ for each submitted token was attempted. None of the five returned a retrievable product listing on 2026-11-20: B0c8moW59 and B0f3GKalj failed outright, and the other three are not ASIN-shaped, so a dp/ lookup for them cannot return a product either.
flags.what_is_missing: Whether the tokens are ever issued ASINs that map to a different product, or are simply unused codes.
flags.impact: If a token is itself a live ASIN, the submitted link and the intended product may be two different things, which would change the editorial plan.
flags.how_to_close: Run a Creators API GetItems call with itemIds set to each token and itemIdType ASIN, and read what comes back.

flags.title: The Associates account behind this site is not publicly verifiable
flags.what_we_checked: The GitHub Pages configuration for this repository is public. The Associates enrolment that would let a reader confirm the site's own account is not.
flags.what_is_missing: Public evidence that the site operator holds an active Associates account and which store ID it uses.
flags.impact: Enrolment, approved Site URLs and payment details all sit behind a login.
flags.how_to_close: Add the live site URL to the approved Site list in Associates Central once the domain is settled.

flags.title: Commission rates for these two categories were not verified
flags.what_we_checked: Amazon states that Standard Commission Income is described in the Appendix of the Program Policies, and that the rate card and payment charts sit behind sign-in.
flags.what_is_missing: The actual percentage for Kitchen and Dining products and for Kitchen Utensils and Gadgets products.
flags.impact: No revenue estimate, ranking or 'highest commission' claim appears anywhere on this site, because none of that could be verified.
flags.how_to_close: Read the rate card in the Program Policies Appendix while signed in, and record it in data/products.json with the date it was read.

flags.title: Creators API access needs 10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days
flags.what_we_checked: Amazon lists the prerequisites for Creators API access, including at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days.
flags.what_is_missing: An API-enabled account, so the live price and availability lookup cannot be exercised yet.
flags.impact: The price and rating widgets on this site stay blank and link out to Amazon instead of showing a figure.
flags.how_to_close: Register for Creators API in Associates Central, then set the API credentials in the server environment rather than in the repository.

flags.title: PA-API 5 no longer works
flags.what_we_checked: Amazon's deprecation notice states that PA-API 5 has been deprecated and that calls now receive an HTTP 403 with an AccessDeniedException.
flags.what_is_missing: Nothing. This is a confirmed change, not an open question.
flags.impact: Any research tooling built against PA-API 5 endpoints would fail silently or loudly. The tooling in this repository targets the Creators API instead.
flags.how_to_close: Already handled. Kept here because it is the single most likely thing to trip up inherited code.

flags.title: No measured search data yet, so no topic ranking is claimed
flags.what_we_checked: Nothing to check yet. The site has been live for less than a day and no search console or analytics property is connected.
flags.what_is_missing: Real query data, impressions, click-through rates and the outbound click and reader capture events this site records.
flags.impact: The publishing plan lists candidate guide topics as hypotheses. None of them is described as popular, high-volume or trending.
flags.how_to_close: Verify the site in Google Search Console, connect the analytics endpoint, publish for a season, then pick the next topic from the measured queries rather than from instinct.

flags.title: Listing contents drift over time
flags.what_we_checked: Amazon's own policies state that prices and availability change, and the Operating Agreement states that the service offerings are provided as is and may change at any time.
flags.what_is_missing: A way to pin the exact text of a listing permanently.
flags.impact: Every title and spec on this site is a snapshot with a date attached, not a live feed.
flags.how_to_close: The register already carries an observed_on date on every row. A scheduled refresh through the Creators API would keep it current.

flags.title: A near-identical ThermoMaven listing exists under a different ASIN
flags.what_we_checked: On the B0DHZTCNR5 listing page read 2026-11-20, Amazon's own 'Customers who viewed this item also viewed' module showed B0GL7Z4KP4 with the title 'ThermoMaven 1 Sec Professional Digital Meat Thermometer, ±0.5℉ Accuracy | NIST&NSF Certified, Auto-Rotate Bright LED Screen, IP67 Waterproof for Grill BBQ, Stocking Stuffers Gifts for Men, Orange'.
flags.what_is_missing: Which of the two ASINs is the listing the owner wants promoted, and whether they are colour variants of one product or separate listings.
flags.impact: Publishing the wrong variant sends readers to a page with different options than the one described.
flags.how_to_close: Check both ASINs in a Creators API GetItems call and confirm the intended colour and variant before publishing a product page for that slot.

flags.title: GitHub Pages logs visitor IP addresses
flags.what_we_checked: GitHub's documentation states that when a GitHub Pages site is visited, the visitor's IP address is logged and stored for security purposes regardless of consent.
flags.what_is_missing: Nothing. This is a published platform behaviour and is recorded so the privacy note is accurate.
flags.impact: The site's own analytics never collects an IP address, but the hosting platform does. The privacy note says so rather than claiming the site is IP-free.
flags.how_to_close: Already disclosed on the site. Listed here so the review is complete.
